analysis: Successful candidate: validation HR@10 increased from 0.605 to 0.645 (+0.040 absolute), exceeding the proposed 0.615–0.625 target. The host selected epoch 10 after completing 30 epochs; validation NDCG@10 was 0.416974. Initializing per-channel residual scales at 0.1 plausibly improved optimization by starting blocks closer to identity while allowing contextual contributions to grow. This single seeded result supports retaining residual scaling, but does not establish the mechanism or cross-seed robustness. No test metrics were consulted.
code_summary: Position-free causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings and eight independent blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block blends local and dilated convolutions through a zero-initialized sigmoid gate with sqrt(2) scaling, then applies a second dilated convolution. A learned 64-channel residual scale initialized to 0.1 multiplies the completed branch after dropout, adding 512 parameters overall. Preserves pre-normalization, GELU, padding masks, last-nonpadding candidate scoring, all interfaces, and existing hyperparameters. Training and evaluation remain entirely host-owned.
